provenance.scope: Original synthetic texture plus unmodified Rust detector/descriptor oracle;289 corners, no Adobe output.
Installed Photoshop2026 action vocabulary; path/hash/line facts, no redistributed Adobe code.
Six projection workflows and reference anchoring; previously read for RAW02 planning. Not exact algorithm/default evidence.

features: Deterministic Harris/steered-BRIEF matching and robust translation/rigid/similarity/homography fitting.
Six real projection choices, automatic Perspective/Cylindrical selection, fixed reference, maximum-weight connected graph and joint transform refinement.
Full-resolution RGB8/16/32 raster/mask warp, disconnected-match rejection, cancellation and bounded allocations.
Native preview/Cancel/OK, reference controls, factory menu, one-step history, native/PSD persistence and same-engine API support.

api.adobe: Both /v1/action-jobs and published /v2/execute-actions interpret installed $Algn content alignment with all six authenticated projection values through the native engine; hosted PNG outputs tested against desktop encoding.
api.endpoint_groups: Five partial/three unimplemented; no invented standalone route.

limits: Two to16 visible ordinary raster layers sharing a parent; Smart Objects, effects, vector masks and clipped layers reject explicitly. One locked reference is allowed for planar modes; curved projections require every selected layer unlocked.

Up to16MP per source/projected layer and32MP combined source/output; registration uses at most900 pixels on the largest dimension with800 corners per input. Production-size performance and difficult/repetitive/low-texture subjects remain unqualified.

Full-resolution bilinear warp replaces moving source rasters. Effective mask coverage is warped and baked into new editable masks; original values are available through Undo. Canvas dimensions/selection remain fixed; off-canvas raster pixels are retained.

No lens distortion/vignette correction, manual control-point editor, EXIF focal-length inference or Photoshop proprietary matching/pixel/default equivalence. The reference is first selected or explicitly chosen, with a locked reference taking precedence by default.

Auto tries Perspective then Cylindrical; Spherical is explicit. Joint transform refinement is bounded to20 iterations, with no joint focal/lens fit. These are deliberate native implementation limits, not asserted Photoshop equality.
Live UI, physical Intel, macOS14/26 and complete Photoshop equality remain open; native NSHosting tests are offscreen. Universal build metadata does not prove physical platform behavior.
Photomerge source loading/new-document orchestration, HDR merging/deghosting and Smart Object statistics remain separate major work.
